&lt;p&gt;3.6. Term (months)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.6.1. 61-360&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.7. Nominal annual interest rate&amp;sup2;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.7.1. Adjustable fixed⁴ (rate can be changed starting from the 37th month)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.7.2. Adjustable fixed⁴ (rate can be changed starting from the 37th month)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.7.3. Adjustable fixed⁴ (rate can be changed starting from the 37th month)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;Fixed component 5.5% + variable component (base rate)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;Fixed component 8% + variable component (base rate)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;Fixed component 7% + variable component (base rate)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;4&quot; width=&quot;1193&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;Term and interest rate in case of online refinancing&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.8. Term (months)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.8.1. 61-360&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.9. Nominal annual interest rate&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.9.1. Adjustable fixed (rate can be changed starting from the 37th month)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;N/a&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;N/a&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;Fixed component 5.25% + variable component (base rate)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;N/a&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;N/a&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.10. Annual percentage rate (APR)&amp;sup3;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.10.1. Adjustable fixed (rate can be changed starting from the 37th month)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.10.2. Adjustable fixed (rate can be changed starting from the 37th month)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.10.3. Adjustable fixed (rate can be changed starting from the 37th month)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;14.35-15.74%&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;10.47-12.39%&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;8.3-10.12%&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11. Other terms related to the interest rate (not applicable in case of online refinancing)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.1. If repayment schedule is differentiated or mixed, the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.5%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.2. If the collateral related ratios (loan-to-value ratio) deviate from those approved by the internal regulations of the Bank, the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.25%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.3. If the creditworthiness criteria deviate from those approved by the internal regulations of the Bank (any or several of the declared income related criteria, OTI and OSM), the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.25%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.4. If the customer prefers a lending option without the early repayment fee, the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.5% (not applicable to loans secured by cash or bonds).&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.5. In case of other deviations, the applicable interest rate may be increased by 0.25%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.12. Lump sum disbursement fee&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.12.1. N/A, except for non-resident individuals, for whom the lump sum loan disbursement fee is 1% of the loan amount or AMD 1 million, whichever is less&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.13. Minimum down payment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; 3.13.1. At least 10% of the purchase price of the property In case of additional collateral: in the amount of 5% of the purchase price.&lt;br /&gt; 3.13.1.1. In case of lending under 2024-2026 state-supported housing programs for families with children: at least 7.5 % of the appraised market price of the residential real estate to be purchased, subject to provision of additional collateral.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.14. Manner of disbursement&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;1. Lump sum&lt;br /&gt; 2. By tranches, in which case the amount/term of each tranche is defined in accordance with the provisions of the agreements executed between the seller company and the borrower.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.15. Cashing of the loan amount by the seller from their account with the Bank after loan disbursement (where applicable)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.15.1. &lt;br /&gt; AMD: Free&lt;br /&gt; Other currency: 0.5 %&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4. Forms of loan repayment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1. Repayment method&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1.1. Annuity (equal monthly installments consisting of a portion of loan and a portion of interest)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1.2. Differentiated (monthly repayment of equal portions of principal amount while interest accrues to outstanding loan and decreases each month) /not applicable in case of online refinancing/&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1.3. Mixed (the customer may choose an individual repayment schedule based on seasonality of cash flows, provided that at least 5% of contractual loan amount is repaid each year; interest payable on monthly basis) /not applicable in case of online refinancing/&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;6&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5. Security&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.1. Eligible collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.1.1.&lt;br /&gt; 1. The loan is secured by the real estate being purchased. The Bank may consider pledge of other real estate as additional security to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank, as well as cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 2. If the borrower wishes to purchase property under construction without registered certificate of title, the loan will be secured by other Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 3. If the borrower wishes to purchase property abroad, the loan will be secured by Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. In the case of online refinancing, the collateral is real estate purchased directly from the developer, which has a completion certificate and is not encumbered with any liabilities other than the refinanced loan.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.2. Loan-to-value (LTV) ratio&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.2.1. The loan is issued:&lt;br /&gt; &amp;nbsp;1. For AMD loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 90%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For AMD loans with a term above 240 months: up to 80%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁶ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 2. For foreign currency loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 70%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For foreign currency loans with a term above 240 months: up to 60%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 3. up to 100% of the value of cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. For up to AMD 30 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 70% (if in Yerevan) and up to 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 30-50 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 60% (if in Yerevan) and up to 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 50-100 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 50% (if in Yerevan) and up to 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.3. Location of the real estate to be pledged&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.3.1. Armenia&lt;br /&gt; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; 5.3.1.1. In case of lending under 2024-2026 state-supported housing programs for families with children, also regional cities of Armenia not specified in clause 5.3.1 and particular rural settlements approved by the Republic of Armenia Government decree N 968-Լ as of May 14, 2020.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.4. Appraisal of the collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.4.1.&lt;br /&gt; 1. No appraisal is required in case of acquisition of the right to purchase property from the developer. Pledge value is considered to be equal to the price specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s reference, unless otherwise determined by the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 2. In case of acquisition of the title to the real estate from the developer, appraisal is performed by appraisal companies cooperating with the Bank.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.5. Additional security&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.5.1. The Bank may request guarantees of individuals and/or companies as additional security.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;4&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6. Insurance of the collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;4&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1. Insurance of the collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1.1. The real estate being pledged is insured by the Bank in the following cases:&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1.1.1. If at the time of registration of the title to the real estate and/or at the time of reappraisal, the market value of the property is over AMD 100 million (one hundred million); or&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://ameriabank.am/Portals/0/files/Other/insured-properties.pdf&quot;&gt;6.1.1.2. if the address of the pledged real estate is included in the list of properties published on the Bank&amp;rsquo;s website. &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1.2. The Bank obtains insurance each year for the amount of the outstanding principal throughout the loan term if any of the above specified conditions is in place (in this case, the calculation of the interest rate also covers all the possible costs, including those associated with the insurance, where applicable).&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;

&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Documentary proof that the down payment was made in a non-cash manner (e.g.: original receipt, or, if paid electronically, a document showing that the electronic payment was confirmed). Such proof is not required if the payment was made from the accounts held with the Bank and the Bank specialist has exported the payment document from the system.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Other documents upon the Bank&amp;rsquo;s request&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;8. Early repayment fee&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;8.1. Early repayment fee&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;8.1.1.&lt;br /&gt; At any time during a contractual year the borrower can make an early repayment to the extent of outstanding principal amount of loan for that contractual year. A contractual year is each period of 12 months following the date of execution of credit agreement.&lt;br /&gt; Where the amount of early repayment exceeds the specified limit, the following fees will be charged:&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.6% of early repayment, if made during the first year of the agreement&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.4% of early repayment, if made during the second year of the agreement&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.2% of early repayment, if made during the third year of the agreement&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;9. Late payment fines and penalties&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;9.1. Late payment fines and penalties&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;9.1.1. The interest rate specified in the loan agreement will continue to be applied to overdue loans. &lt;br /&gt; Fine in the amount of 0.13 % of overdue loan and interest for each day of delay&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;10. Other fees&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;10.1. Other fees&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;10.1.1. Fees payable by the customers for the new loans &lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fee for unified statement from the State Committee of Real Estate Cadaster of the Government of the Republic of Armenia&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fees for notarization of pledge (real estate), registration of the Bank&amp;rsquo;s security interest under pledge agreement, and&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Appraisal fee for the real estate being pledged (as necessary)&lt;br /&gt; 10.1.2 Fees payable by the Bank for the loans refinanced online&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fee for unified statement from the State Committee of Real Estate Cadaster of the Government of the Republic of Armenia&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fees for notarization of pledge (real estate), registration of the Bank&amp;rsquo;s security interest under pledge agreement, and&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Appraisal fee for the real estate being pledged&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;11. Creditworthiness assessment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;11.1 Without creditworthiness assessment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: line-through;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;Where the loan amount is AMD 50-100 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 50% (if in Yerevan) or 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is AMD 30-50 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 40% (if in Yerevan) or 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is up to AMD 30 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 30% (if in Yerevan) or 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;sup&gt;1&lt;/sup&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;These terms have been previously known as Retail Lending Terms and Conditions under code 11RBD PL 72-03-01. Some of the Bank documents may contain references to these terms and conditions under the former name and code.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;sup2;Depending on the creditworthiness of the borrower, term of loan and LTV ratio, a higher or lower interest rate can be applied.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;sup3;The annual percentage rate (APR) may differ from the above specified values if there is any or a few of the following factors:&lt;br /&gt; - When the property insurance is obtained by the Bank at the customer&amp;rsquo;s request &lt;br /&gt; - When the borrower selects differentiated or mixed form of loan repayment&lt;br /&gt; - If there are deviations from the creditworthiness criteria approved under the internal regulations of the Bank&lt;br /&gt; - If additional property is pledged as collateral&lt;br /&gt; - If there are other deviations&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;⁴ Attention! The adjustable nominal interest rate may be revised no more than twice a year. Furthermore, depending on the change of the adjustable nominal interest rate, the threshold above or below which the nominal rate cannot change is &amp;plusmn;5%.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;⁵ The list of developers is determined by the Bank. If the developer is not included in the Bank&#x27;s list, the terms of the loans for purchase of residential real estate from secondary market will apply.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;/tbody&gt;  
&lt;/table&gt;  
&lt;/div&gt;

<div style="border-left:5px solid #98a2b3;background:#ffffff;padding:0.55em 0.8em;margin:1.2em 0 0.65em 0;"><strong>UNASSESSED</strong> &nbsp; <code>api:16:90af19d6f6b6:block:15106</code><br><small>No source-discovery assessment was produced.</small></div>

&lt;div class=&quot;table-scroll&quot;&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Home Purchase Loan (primary market)&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;td rowspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;1. Purpose&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;1.1. Purpose&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; rowspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; 1.1.1. (i) Purchase of residential property (including parking space) for residential, lease or investment purposes, or (ii) transfer of a loan for purchase of property for residential, lease or investment purposes from another bank/credit organization to Ameriabank CJSC (the &amp;ldquo;Bank&amp;rdquo;)&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2. Customer&amp;rsquo;s personal details&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.1. Eligible age of the customer/co-borrower/guarantor&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.1.1. 18-70 years old, provided that the borrower&#x27;s age at the time of expiry of loan agreement will not have exceeded 70, otherwise a co-borrower or guarantor is required. The eligible age of co-borrower or guarantor is 18-70 provided that at the time of expiry of agreement it will not have exceeded 70.&lt;br /&gt; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;If involvement of a co-borrower or guarantor is a required condition under loan terms (except where co-borrowers or guarantors possess at least 70% of income included in OTI calculation), the eligible age of the co-borrower or guarantor is 18-70 provided that at the time of expiry of agreement it will not have exceeded 70.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.2. Residency&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.2.1. For loans in AMD: citizens and non-citizens of Armenia who are resident in Armenia&lt;br /&gt; For loans in foreign currency: individuals not considered residents of Armenia&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;26&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3. Loan terms&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.1. Currency&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.1.1. AMD&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.1.2. USD&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.1.2. EUR&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.2. Minimum and maximum loan limits&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;296&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.2.1. &lt;br /&gt; AMD 3,000,000 - AMD 150,000,000&lt;br /&gt; For online refinancing: AMD 3,000,000-100,000,000&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;td rowspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11. Other terms related to the interest rate (not applicable in case of online refinancing)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.1. If repayment schedule is differentiated or mixed, the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.5%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.2. If the collateral related ratios (loan-to-value ratio) deviate from those approved by the internal regulations of the Bank, the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.25%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.3. If the creditworthiness criteria deviate from those approved by the internal regulations of the Bank (any or several of the declared income related criteria, OTI and OSM), the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.25%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.4. If the customer prefers a lending option without the early repayment fee, the applicable interest rate is increased by 0.5% (not applicable to loans secured by cash or bonds).&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.11.5. In case of other deviations, the applicable interest rate may be increased by 0.25%.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.12. Lump sum disbursement fee&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.12.1. N/A, except for non-resident individuals, for whom the lump sum loan disbursement fee is 1% of the loan amount or AMD 1 million, whichever is less&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.13. Minimum down payment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; 3.13.1. At least 10% of the purchase price of the property In case of additional collateral: in the amount of 5% of the purchase price.&lt;br /&gt; 3.13.1.1. In case of lending under 2024-2026 state-supported housing programs for families with children: at least 7.5 % of the appraised market price of the residential real estate to be purchased, subject to provision of additional collateral.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.14. Manner of disbursement&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;1. Lump sum&lt;br /&gt; 2. By tranches, in which case the amount/term of each tranche is defined in accordance with the provisions of the agreements executed between the seller company and the borrower.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.15. Cashing of the loan amount by the seller from their account with the Bank after loan disbursement (where applicable)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.15.1. &lt;br /&gt; AMD: Free&lt;br /&gt; Other currency: 0.5 %&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4. Forms of loan repayment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1. Repayment method&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1.1. Annuity (equal monthly installments consisting of a portion of loan and a portion of interest)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1.2. Differentiated (monthly repayment of equal portions of principal amount while interest accrues to outstanding loan and decreases each month) /not applicable in case of online refinancing/&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;4.1.3. Mixed (the customer may choose an individual repayment schedule based on seasonality of cash flows, provided that at least 5% of contractual loan amount is repaid each year; interest payable on monthly basis) /not applicable in case of online refinancing/&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;6&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5. Security&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.1. Eligible collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.1.1.&lt;br /&gt; 1. The loan is secured by the real estate being purchased. The Bank may consider pledge of other real estate as additional security to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank, as well as cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 2. If the borrower wishes to purchase property under construction without registered certificate of title, the loan will be secured by other Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 3. If the borrower wishes to purchase property abroad, the loan will be secured by Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. In the case of online refinancing, the collateral is real estate purchased directly from the developer, which has a completion certificate and is not encumbered with any liabilities other than the refinanced loan.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.2. Loan-to-value (LTV) ratio&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.2.1. The loan is issued:&lt;br /&gt; &amp;nbsp;1. For AMD loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 90%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For AMD loans with a term above 240 months: up to 80%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁶ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 2. For foreign currency loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 70%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For foreign currency loans with a term above 240 months: up to 60%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 3. up to 100% of the value of cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. For up to AMD 30 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 70% (if in Yerevan) and up to 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 30-50 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 60% (if in Yerevan) and up to 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 50-100 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 50% (if in Yerevan) and up to 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.3. Location of the real estate to be pledged&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.3.1. Armenia&lt;br /&gt; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; 5.3.1.1. In case of lending under 2024-2026 state-supported housing programs for families with children, also regional cities of Armenia not specified in clause 5.3.1 and particular rural settlements approved by the Republic of Armenia Government decree N 968-Լ as of May 14, 2020.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.4. Appraisal of the collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.4.1.&lt;br /&gt; 1. No appraisal is required in case of acquisition of the right to purchase property from the developer. Pledge value is considered to be equal to the price specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s reference, unless otherwise determined by the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 2. In case of acquisition of the title to the real estate from the developer, appraisal is performed by appraisal companies cooperating with the Bank.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.5. Additional security&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;5.5.1. The Bank may request guarantees of individuals and/or companies as additional security.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;4&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6. Insurance of the collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;4&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1. Insurance of the collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1.1. The real estate being pledged is insured by the Bank in the following cases:&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1.1.1. If at the time of registration of the title to the real estate and/or at the time of reappraisal, the market value of the property is over AMD 100 million (one hundred million); or&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://ameriabank.am/Portals/0/files/Other/insured-properties.pdf&quot;&gt;6.1.1.2. if the address of the pledged real estate is included in the list of properties published on the Bank&amp;rsquo;s website. &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;6.1.2. The Bank obtains insurance each year for the amount of the outstanding principal throughout the loan term if any of the above specified conditions is in place (in this case, the calculation of the interest rate also covers all the possible costs, including those associated with the insurance, where applicable).&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;19&quot; width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;7. Required documents&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td rowspan=&quot;19&quot; width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;7.1. Required documents&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;7.1.1. Required documents filed together with the loan application&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Loan application (not applicable in case of online refinancing)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; ID (original)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;bull; Certificate of ownership/purchase right of real estate to be purchased/pledged (copy)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Other documents upon the Bank&amp;rsquo;s request&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;7.1.2. Documents required after pre-approval&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;bull; Proof of employment and/or other income (not applicable in case of online refinancing)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;bull; Marriage (divorce, spouse death) certificate (original)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Certificate of title to real estate to be pledged (original)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Other documents upon the Bank request&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;7.1.3. Documents required after loan approval &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Copies of bases of title to real estate (to be submitted upon the Bank&amp;rsquo;s request)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; IDs of owners of the property to be purchased/pledged (originals)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Copies of marriage (divorce, spouse death) certificates of owners of the property to be pledged, to be presented if available&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Statement from the State Committee of Real Estate Cadaster on encumbrance of real estate (unified statement)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Tax clearance certificate for the real estate&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Real estate insurance policy (as required)&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Documentary proof that the down payment was made in a non-cash manner (e.g.: original receipt, or, if paid electronically, a document showing that the electronic payment was confirmed). Such proof is not required if the payment was made from the accounts held with the Bank and the Bank specialist has exported the payment document from the system.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;bull; Other documents upon the Bank&amp;rsquo;s request&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;8. Early repayment fee&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;8.1. Early repayment fee&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;8.1.1.&lt;br /&gt; At any time during a contractual year the borrower can make an early repayment to the extent of outstanding principal amount of loan for that contractual year. A contractual year is each period of 12 months following the date of execution of credit agreement.&lt;br /&gt; Where the amount of early repayment exceeds the specified limit, the following fees will be charged:&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.6% of early repayment, if made during the first year of the agreement&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.4% of early repayment, if made during the second year of the agreement&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.2% of early repayment, if made during the third year of the agreement&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;9. Late payment fines and penalties&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;9.1. Late payment fines and penalties&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;9.1.1. The interest rate specified in the loan agreement will continue to be applied to overdue loans. &lt;br /&gt; Fine in the amount of 0.13 % of overdue loan and interest for each day of delay&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;10. Other fees&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;10.1. Other fees&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;10.1.1. Fees payable by the customers for the new loans &lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fee for unified statement from the State Committee of Real Estate Cadaster of the Government of the Republic of Armenia&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fees for notarization of pledge (real estate), registration of the Bank&amp;rsquo;s security interest under pledge agreement, and&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Appraisal fee for the real estate being pledged (as necessary)&lt;br /&gt; 10.1.2 Fees payable by the Bank for the loans refinanced online&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fee for unified statement from the State Committee of Real Estate Cadaster of the Government of the Republic of Armenia&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Fees for notarization of pledge (real estate), registration of the Bank&amp;rsquo;s security interest under pledge agreement, and&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Appraisal fee for the real estate being pledged&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;63&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;11. Creditworthiness assessment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;11.1 Without creditworthiness assessment&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: line-through;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;Where the loan amount is AMD 50-100 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 50% (if in Yerevan) or 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is AMD 30-50 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 40% (if in Yerevan) or 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is up to AMD 30 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 30% (if in Yerevan) or 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;sup&gt;1&lt;/sup&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;These terms have been previously known as Retail Lending Terms and Conditions under code 11RBD PL 72-03-01. Some of the Bank documents may contain references to these terms and conditions under the former name and code.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;sup2;Depending on the creditworthiness of the borrower, term of loan and LTV ratio, a higher or lower interest rate can be applied.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&amp;sup3;The annual percentage rate (APR) may differ from the above specified values if there is any or a few of the following factors:&lt;br /&gt; - When the property insurance is obtained by the Bank at the customer&amp;rsquo;s request &lt;br /&gt; - When the borrower selects differentiated or mixed form of loan repayment&lt;br /&gt; - If there are deviations from the creditworthiness criteria approved under the internal regulations of the Bank&lt;br /&gt; - If additional property is pledged as collateral&lt;br /&gt; - If there are other deviations&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;⁴ Attention! The adjustable nominal interest rate may be revised no more than twice a year. Furthermore, depending on the change of the adjustable nominal interest rate, the threshold above or below which the nominal rate cannot change is &amp;plusmn;5%.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;⁵ The list of developers is determined by the Bank. If the developer is not included in the Bank&#x27;s list, the terms of the loans for purchase of residential real estate from secondary market will apply.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;/tbody&gt;  
&lt;/table&gt;  
&lt;/div&gt;

overflow-x: scroll;

&lt;p&gt;6.1.1.&lt;br&gt; At any time during a contractual year the borrower can make an early repayment to the extent of outstanding principal amount of loan for that contractual year. A contractual year is each period of 12 months following the date of execution of credit agreement.&lt;br&gt; Where the amount of early repayment exceeds the specified limit, the following fees will be charged:&lt;br&gt; • Max 0.6% of early repayment, if made during the first year of the agreement&lt;br&gt; • Max 0.4% of early repayment, if made during the second year of the agreement&lt;br&gt; • Max 0.2% of early repayment, if made during the third year of the agreement&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;2.2.1.&lt;br&gt; The loan is issued:&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &lt;br&gt; For AMD loans with a term of 61-240 months: 80%² (if in Yerevan) and 70% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property,&lt;br&gt; For AMD loans with a term above 240 months: 70%² (if in Yerevan) and 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property,&lt;br&gt; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;295&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.3. Location of the real estate to be pledged&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;876&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.3.1. Yerevan, regional centers of Armenia, towns where Ameriabank has branches, as well as Jrvezh, Arinj, Dzoraghbyur, Kasakh, Tsaghkadzor, Masis and Yeghvard&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;295&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.4. Appraisal of the collateral&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;876&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;2.4.1. Pledged property to be appraised by an appraising partner of the Bank.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;79&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3. Term of fulfillment of conditions of loan&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;295&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.1. Term of fulfillment of conditions of loan&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;876&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;3.1.1. Loans are disbursed in tranches. Each tranche is subject to proper use of previous tranche for the intended loan purpose by the borrower except where the amount of loan is AMD 7 million or less or the loan has been transferred from another bank, in which cases the sum is disbursed lump-sum.&lt;br&gt; For loans over AMD 50 million contractual amount at least 3 tranches must be defined.&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;1249&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;¹Attention! The offer of the agreement is provided to the client following which the client may use the 7-day cooling-off period envisaged by the Armenian laws and regulations.&lt;br&gt; In case of failure to notarize the pledge agreements specified in the loan agreement and securing the borrower&#x27;s obligations under the loan agreement, within 30 (thirty) business days upon execution of the loan agreement and acceptance by the Borrower, the Agreement shall cease to be valid (unless the loan has already been disbursed to the borrower by that date). &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;1249&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;² Attention! The adjustable nominal interest rate may be revised no more than twice a year. Furthermore, depending on the change of the adjustable nominal interest rate, the threshold above or below which the nominal rate cannot change is 5%.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;tr&gt;  
&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;1249&quot;&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;³The list of developers is determined by the Bank.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;  
&lt;/tr&gt;  
&lt;/tbody&gt;  
&lt;/table&gt;  
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;div&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;Required documents filed together with loan application&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;ul&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Loan application&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;ID [original]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Certificate of ownership of property to be purchased/pledged [copy]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;/ul&gt;  
&lt;div&gt;Documents required after initial approval&lt;/div&gt;  
&lt;ul&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Proof of employment and/or other income&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Marriage (divorce, spouse death), birth certificate [original]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Certificate of title to real estate to be pledged [original]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Geodetic measurement report of land plot to be pledged**&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Initial real estate appraisal report&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Construction costs estimate&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;/ul&gt;  
&lt;div&gt;Documents required after loan approval&amp;nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;  
&lt;ul&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Copies of bases of title to real estate (to be submitted upon request)&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;IDs of owners of property to be purchased/pledged [originals]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Copies of marriage (divorce, spouse death) certificates of owners of property to be pledged&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Statement from the State Committee of Real Estate Cadaster on encumbrance of real estate (unified statement)&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Real estate appraisal report (final)&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Other documents as the bank&#x27;s specialist may request&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;i&gt;Depending on various circumstances, the bank may request other documents and information. Where required under the Republic of Armenia Law “On Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing”, we may request you to provide additional information and documents to conduct “Know your customer” check, as well as ask further questions during verbal communication.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div&gt;  
&lt;p&gt;Required documents filed together with loan application&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;ul&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Loan application&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;ID [original]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Certificate of ownership of property to be purchased/pledged [copy]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;/ul&gt;  
&lt;div&gt;Documents required after initial approval&lt;/div&gt;  
&lt;ul&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Proof of employment and/or other income&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Marriage (divorce, spouse death), birth certificate [original]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Certificate of title to real estate to be pledged [original]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Geodetic measurement report of land plot to be pledged**&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Initial real estate appraisal report&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Construction costs estimate&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;/ul&gt;  
&lt;div&gt;Documents required after loan approval&amp;nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;  
&lt;ul&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Copies of bases of title to real estate (to be submitted upon request)&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;IDs of owners of property to be purchased/pledged [originals]&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Copies of marriage (divorce, spouse death) certificates of owners of property to be pledged&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Statement from the State Committee of Real Estate Cadaster on encumbrance of real estate (unified statement)&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Real estate appraisal report (final)&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;li&gt;Other documents as the bank&#x27;s specialist may request&lt;/li&gt;  
&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;i&gt;Depending on various circumstances, the bank may request other documents and information. Where required under the Republic of Armenia Law “On Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing”, we may request you to provide additional information and documents to conduct “Know your customer” check, as well as ask further questions during verbal communication.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;/p&gt;  
&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
